definition: Timing and sequence of pilot and main-fuel start/end events and their overlap or dwell.
notes: Chronology is directly supported for mixture and combustion response; it is not a shock-loading measurement.

node_name: Injector pressure build-up and valve-opening state
definition: Time-resolved injector pressure and opening history that precede a quasi-steady discharge state.
notes: Formation, instantaneous, overshoot, and stabilized states remain distinct.

node_name: Nozzle ambient and gas boundary state
definition: Nozzle geometry, supply and ambient thermodynamic state, gas properties, and pressure-definition basis.
notes: NPR is contextual and cannot replace the complete boundary state.

definition: Developing choked or underexpanded gas-jet state before and during approach to quasi-steady behavior.
notes: Direct in gas-jet studies; HPDI-local resolution is less complete.

definition: Mach-disk formation, axial location, size, motion, overshoot, and stabilized state.
notes: Position is better constrained than diameter, curvature, or appearance threshold.

definition: Barrel shocks, shock cells, expansion waves, and shock-vortex organization downstream of the nozzle.
notes: Mach disk, shock cells, and pressure waves are retained as distinct observables.

node_name: Local gas pressure density and velocity state
definition: Spatially and temporally resolved gas state produced by shocks, expansions, vortices, or reflected waves.
notes: Directly resolved in analogues; not co-located with HPDI pilot droplets in the corpus.

definition: Pressure jump, density jump, relative velocity, aerodynamic stress, and their spatial nonuniformity experienced by a droplet or spray element.
notes: The B-to-C mapping is qualitative unless local state and reference frame are measured.

definition: Typed exposure interval such as shock-front passage, shocked-state duration, expansion-limited loading, or total forcing.
notes: Different interval types are not interchangeable.

definition: Definition-complete Mach context, Weber, Reynolds, Ohnesorge, density ratio, size, and loading-scale descriptors.
notes: No universal single-parameter collapse is supported.

definition: Shock transmission, refraction, focusing, pressure extrema, and circulation preceding bulk deformation.
notes: Phase state and wave-speed ratio limit transfer.

definition: Time-dependent flattening, displacement, cross-stream growth, sheets, rims, and other pre-fragmentation morphology.
notes: Mostly isolated or ordered droplets.

definition: Condition-dependent RT, KH, shear-stripping, capillary-retraction, sheet-rupture, and wake competition.
notes: Regime labels require matched definitions and forcing history.

definition: Fragment-producing transition from deformed parent droplets through sheets, ligaments, piercing, or stripping.
notes: C004 remains a source-availability limitation for broad taxonomy.

definition: Fragment size, velocity, spacing, mass distribution, and time-dependent cloud descriptors after breakup.
notes: Statistics are diagnostically sparse and sampling definitions vary.

definition: Wake shielding, squeeze flow, channel closure, collective attenuation, and population-dependent loading redistribution.
notes: Ordered arrangements and dilute clouds do not directly represent dense reacting HPDI sprays.

definition: Acceleration, cloud growth, penetration, lateral spreading, and entrainment of fragments or sprays.
notes: Direct transport evidence exists but product distributions are incomplete.

definition: Heating, vaporization, Stefan flow, vapor-layer effects, evaporation time or length, and droplet survival.
notes: Phase change may suppress or promote breakup depending on thermal and interfacial state.

definition: Fuel-air and pilot-product spatial redistribution through injection, overlap, entrainment, transport, evaporation, and wall interaction.
notes: Direct for injection chronology and geometry; shock-breakup contribution is not isolated.

definition: Ignition delay, ignition location, pilot/main interaction, radical and heat transport, and reaction-front development.
notes: Direct HPDI evidence concerns chronology and mixture state rather than a closed shock-mediated chain.

definition: Premixed versus mixing-controlled heat release, flame propagation, stability, pressure-rise, and emissions response.
notes: Operating point and diagnostic definitions bound generalization.

definition: Two-way coupling between droplet breakup or evaporation scales and detonation/RDE wave structure, speed, multiplicity, or stability.
notes: Strong-wave application analogue only for transfer to HPDI.
